---
title: "Starting from CLAUDE.md"
date: 2026-11-05
description: "The first hour of the project: Step 0, the first theory post, an outside review, and six rounds of API questions before any physics is written."
---

The first session of the project. The repository held `CLAUDE.md` and an
empty package skeleton, and the first message asks Claude to work out from
that file what to do next.

The excerpt runs for about an hour and shows the milestone workflow being
followed for the first time: Claude finishes Step 0 and stops at a theory post;
the post is reviewed by Mads-Peter and by a second model outside the session;
Claude checks the review's numbers before acting on it; and the API is settled
through rounds of questions before the acceptance tests are written. It ends
with the tests committed and failing, because the package they test does not
exist yet.

What came of it: the [theory post](../theory/01a_empty_lattice.qmd) and, later
the same morning, the [validation](../validation/01a_empty_lattice.qmd) of
Milestone 1a.
